name: Regex Tester
summary: Test JavaScript regular expressions with live matches, groups, and replace preview — in your browser.
description: Write a pattern with flags (g i m s u y), see highlighted matches, capture groups, and a replace preview. Invalid patterns show clear errors. Everything runs locally.

faqs.question: Which regex flavor is this?
faqs.answer: JavaScript (ECMAScript) RegExp — the same engine your browser uses.

faqs.question: What do the flag buttons mean?
faqs.answer: g global, i ignore case, m multiline, s dotAll, u unicode, y sticky.

faqs.question: Is my text uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Matching runs entirely in your browser.
